statements.subject: message
statements.description: The range MAY include media type parameters that are generally applicable to that range.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Each media type or range MAY be followed by one or more accept-params, beginning with the "q" parameter to indicate a relative quality factor.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If no Accept header field is present, then it is assumed that the client accepts all media types.  If an Accept header field is present, and if the server cannot send a response that is acceptable according to the combined Accept field-value, then the server SHOULD send a 406 (Not Acceptable) response.
statements.pre_cond: request.method = DESCRIBE & request.Accept_header_present = true & server.can_satisfy_Accept = false
